nodes.label: build workflow
nodes.rationale: Verifies bun run build produces a usable dist/ (entry point plus type declarations) and that the committed DevTools UI bundle was generated from the sources in the tree. Path-filtered to build inputs so docs-only, test-only and README changes skip and the actions queue stays focused.

nodes.label: check:ui source-hash staleness gate
nodes.rationale: The bundle is committed on purpose so a fresh clone can typecheck, test and smoke without running the UI build - which is exactly what made staleness invisible: the file is valid TypeScript whether or not its contents are current, so a stale one sailed through typecheck and the entire suite. The step runs BEFORE the build, and that ordering is load-bearing: build is build:ui && tsc, so any check after it would pass by construction. It compares the header source-hash rather than rebuilding and diffing bytes, because the bytes are not a function of the sources alone - gzip stamps the OS into every member and bun-version: latest moves the minifier, so a byte diff fires on bundles that are perfectly current (#521).

nodes.label: dist/ artifact assertion
nodes.rationale: Asserts dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts exist after tsc, so a build that emits nothing usable is red rather than silently green.
